description: Agent Bookkeeping: submit the accounts payable ledger with the ledger balance it should total to: the payables report with its reference, the day it is read on, its currency, each vendor bill with its id, vendor, bill number, bill date, due date, amount, the amount paid and its status (open, paid or void), and each vendor credit with its vendor, credit memo number, amount and the amount applied; the ledger with its date, currency and accounts payable balance. The signed report gives the payables report and the books, each vendor bill entered more than once, each bill paid beyond its amount, each vendor credit left unapplied, the open bills less unapplied credits totalled against the ledger balance, and each open bill past its due date, and counts them, and names a divergent payables ledger: a duplicate vendor bill, a bill overpaid, a vendor credit never applied, and vendor totals unlike the ledger’s accounts payable balance; then a bill past due and another currency, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No bills, no vendor with a bill number or dated amount, no bill amounts, or no ledger balance leaves those points unverified. Vendors read as parties without case, punctuation or a legal suffix, bill numbers by their letters and digits, and amounts to the cent in one currency. This checks the payables ledger itself: wever_invoice-check reads a single invoice document against its job or mandate and wever_invoice-aging-brief briefs receivable aging, while the payables check reads every vendor bill and credit together against the ledger balance. Verdict bookkeeping_payables_divergent, bookkeeping_payables_partial, bookkeeping_payables_unverified or bookkeeping_payables_consistent. POST /api/bookkeeping-payables-check. Reads the bookkeeping records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the books as supplied only: it never posts or edits an entry, never moves money or pays a bill, never files anything with any authority and gives no tax advice, which stay with the business, its bookkeeper and its advisers, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Bookkeeping reads a business’s own books for internal consistency and against the records they should agree with: a general-ledger extract, a bank reconciliation, journal entries, a chart of accounts, a period close, the accounts payable ledger, a payroll register and the accounts receivable ledger, each against its own debits and credits, the source totals supplied, the bank statement and the ledger balance, the open period, the posting queue and recurring entries, or the ledger postings and pay schedule it should agree with. The family reads bookkeeping, the record a business keeps of its own transactions in its ledger and journals, and reads the records against each other. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-bookkeeping-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-bookkeeping/.
